text: Nothing like the ads (as usual with mobile games these days.) Also this is a "pay to win" game and is not friendly to players that don't want to spend money. After a certain amount of progression, the game shifts in a way that encourages you to spend. For example; upgrades take longer, resources are harder to get, and exploring gets tougher, players can attack your base. If you don't mind spending, this might be the game for you. If you're a f2p player then this game isn't good.

I downloaded the app because of the ads being fun, but there's none of that "run your little guy around and do some chores" energy that the ads have. It's just standard farming and upgrading buildings and waiting in real-time for your wares to restock, just like any Facebook farming game from the early 2010s. If you're into that sort of thing, it's fine, but I'm not, I find that sort of thing boring, so I'd not recommend it personally.

The game has everything you could want, it's fun, you can put as much time in as you want, good people. Then the fun ends. Initially it's a fair balanced game, a few purchases here and there to get you places quicker, but the more you advance, the more it'll cost, but youve invested so much time that you wont want to quit. Within 3 months, you could very easily go from spending £5 a week to £50 a day on this game in order to keep up with progression and it's never enough. An addictive money pit

It's a good game up until a point. But eventually it becomes so long to build / upgrade things, that it becomes pointless to play unless you're going to pay for speedups etc. And when I say long, I mean 21 actual real world days to upgrade a furnace. So unless you pay, you basically can't do anything else for 21 days. Not sure who's idea that was, but I've pretty much stopped playing all together now.

Played about 15 mins, no enjoyment in this supposed game. It's just a case of click the next objective, click the button to upgrade/assign a person, click the next objective, click the button to upgrade etc and repeat. There isn't really any player interaction, and of course it's nothing like the ads. Maybe it'll get more enjoyable later on but I'm not willing to be mindlessly tapping buttons to get that point.

Nothing like the ad that encouraged me to download this. Very time consuming game that can be free to play, but (like most mobile games) pushes in game purchases. There's also a lot going on in the game, and it's hard to keep track of everything. Attempted to delete my account today, which was unnecessarily complex. Overall, probably one of the better mobile games out there, but not my favourite.

When I started playing, I hated the game.. then it grew into me after a while.. and then some time passed and I hated it all over again. First of, there are too many speedups tasks within the game but very limited sources of speedups.. especially if you're a free player. Secondly, the shops are useless.. majority of the items are just 1 in the shop and you have to wait for a day or a week for a refresh.. also, once that item is bought, it's sold out. Hahaha.. very useless.

Poor initial starting experience, doesn't let me play the game, just cutscene, click this, click that, claim. I've learned nothing and the game is holding my hand the entire way. Give full control back to the user, let them figure stuff out in their own pace. Within seconds I've interacted with multiple buildings with lots of options and not had time to ease into it. Dev I suggest you go back and study old games. They don't need this holdy-hand bs because they designed their game well.

nothing like the adverts which was a bit disappointing. The game is a bit repetitive. upgrade building, spam all unlocked minor building upgrades. rinse and repeat. By the time you do the exact same upgrade in 6 houses you will lose the will to live. you will quickly reach a point where you have all the resources you need. I played up to chapter 9 but now it wants me to join an alliance. Personally I prefer solo games so this is as far as I go.

This game is a total scam, it is literally nothing, NOTHING, like the ads at all, what-so-ever, not even slightly. It's actually a PvP MMO, except the people who pour tons and tons of money into the game just dominate and bully everyone, attacking their bases non-stop just because they can, because they paid for better armies. The game is unbearable.

The gameplay is extremely fun, balanced and enjoyable.. well until you've played for about an hour. Soon you will realise that this is just another pay to win game where you need to spend money if you want to progress at a reasonable rate. Obviously you aren't forced to spent money, but if you want even one chance at keeping up with other players and advancing quicker than a snail then you are basically forced to spend money. If you don't have deep pockets then don't even bother installing.

It is kind of fun, sure, but it is quite clearly just designed to suck the most money out of its players, rather than actually being a better game. It starts off being a survival game where you expand your base so that your people survive. And then you quickly level up to a point where that is all meaningless - it just becomes slow upgrades that you can pay to speed up, and gambling events that you have to pay to complete fully... I have played for months, but it just stopped being fun

I got banned for getting a refund I got by mistake. Was told to play I had to repurchase it. I'd already spent over £200 on the game so it's quite pathetic and petty to do that over a purchase in error. The game itself is ok. Nothing special but it kills time for a disabled person. Don't believe the ads you see, the gameplay is nothing like them. It's also a bit confusing at times as well.

I am uninstalling this until the game improves it's economy. If the devs want to monetize the game they should do it with in-game decorative items or event items that don't affect their levels and gameplay. I played this game with friends and we are not that rich to buy the levels and even if we start from the beginning in a new world there will always be people who are 5 or 6 levels ahead just by buying their levels and ruining other people's progress by raiding with high lvl troops. I hate it.

The game is not as advertised. This is designed in way that makes you purchase more and more overtime making you think you are falling behind. Except the social element of the game nothing in it is actually as advertised and the gameplay is slow. In the game are players referred to as whales and people spend serious amounts of money to stay in the top. Free to play people do not have chance to enjoy it as some items and rewards are available only after purchases.

While this game definetly deserves more than 3 stars I believe it can be improved further, It would be nice if resources could run out faster, that way you would have to think about the best course of action on how to survive. This is a survival game after all, I suppose it wouldn't hurt if snow storms lasted longer than 12 minutes and were to be a bit stronger than they are currently, otherwise I love this game and would mostlikely recommend it to some friends.

To start with, THE GAME IN THE ADVERT DOES NOT EXIST. Instant 1/5 stars. That being said it's an okay game, would've rated a few stars higher otherwise. It does seem to be one of those games where eventually it's going to make you spend money to continue playing with it's exponential times to build. The advert and buying system is like something from temu, just trying to bait and tempt you into paying up for "4000% off!" offers.

I have spent over £3,600 on in-app purchases in this game, and I noticed a couple of my transactions had been charged twice, so I had the duplicates refunded with a total value of £54.98. Because I claimed back the overcharged transactions, the developers have banned me and will not unban me unless I re-pay the refunded money, which would then mean I've been charged twice again! Even with the £55 refunded, they still have over £3,600 of my money in the game, which they are preventing access to.

There's so much pressure to buy in app packs, and so many predatory tricks to trick you into buying things you didn't even want. I felt physically sick when I realised how much I had spent on this, money I don't have. Even after spending money, you can still be easily crushed by anyone who spends more than you. Their game is free to play if you enjoy being crushed constantly by people who spend all their money. Don't even download it, it's not worth the risk.

This is very much a pay to win, and in some instances pay to play game though if you can join a decent enough alliance and then somewhat coast off their trails and successes then you can go quite far in the game. It can be fun to pick up and put down, number go higher make brain go brrr kind of game. It's absolutely nothing like the ads.

Just a typical pay to play game. If they used their talent to make something playable then I am sure it could be great. They draw you in with little games on the advert and these have nothing to do with the actual gameplay you will experience when you download it. I imagine these games either go one of two ways, you either get hooked and spend a fortune, or you just get bored fairly quickly and lose interest. I was the latter!

Played for a year, now deleted! - you can play without paying, but you basically have to be on it everyday & are constantly at a disadvantage (you can be wiped out in seconds if you miss something). The longer you play, the longer it takes to progress. New 'mini games' are constantly being added taking more & more of your time & you have to engage & 'get along' with 100s of other players worldwide to survive. Fun for a while but becomes increasingly demanding & ultimately goes nowhere.

Another game that is NOTHING like the adverts 😓. You are sucked into one of those games that require you to have fights that can be automated, build your facilities for research, combat and exploration outside your city where you're frequently asked to join an alliance (yeah one of those games) which means your city will eventually get attacked and you do it over and over again🙄. 😤😫The advert games you get playing other games is better, well its the reason why I downloaded it.😒

Massively pay to win and overpriced. If you're not in the top alliance, eventually you'll get attacked and you can loose close to nearly everything, making all the money you've spent and all the time you've put in thrown in the bin. On top of that, UK players are being ripped off. From talking to other players, £5 = $5 in the game, but we all know that £5 doesn't equal $5, that's not how currency works, so essentially UK players are being ripped off. How is that even legal?

Game itself is good at first, but it's really just another carbon copy of games like War and Order, Last Survivor, Age of Origins, Dominations, Envoy and countless others. It's a pay to win conquest style game and nothing like the survival style game it started off as or that was shown in the ads. It's just another boring "build and upgrade a city with increasingly stupid build times as you go and build a big army that you need to invest money in" type of game. I'm just sick and tired of them.

Nothing at all like the adverts. It's like the generic upgrade-your-town-and-then-access-a-big-map-of-other-people-and-alliances. If you like them it's probably quite a good one, but the play store was full of them a while back so they have become boring. It also rushes you through upgrading your town and gets you quickly to the part where you have to pay or progress at snails pace. That's where I always stop these "games" - (money traps aiming to get you hooked and enticing you to pay)

Terrible game. Rng is just algorithms designed to squeeze money out of you. Horrible support. They won't allow me to bind the account to another email even after i gave them all the info needed,including recent receipts and from the creation of the account. Do yourselves a favor and uninstall. It's a money grab. You will never be able to compete with whales that are putting thousands into gear and heroes that never stop coming.

Nice little game but it's not as advertised. it's also takes days to complete things and you just wait. you need to be in an active alliance to actually enjoy most events otherwise you can't get items or participate. some lovely little side games pop up though. Biggest annoyance is there seems to be an update every month and half and you need almost 2GB free to install them, otherwise you can't get into the game. It's been fun but I'll be uninstalling.

Do not play this game if you don't have money to spend. The developers are very greedy, upgrades cost too much money which only the big spenders can get quickly. You can get some upgrades in games but it will take you months to save. For example, you can't upgrade legendary gear without money as the time needed is only available via money. The new event frost tyrant dragon was just a real mess. It's the worst event ever in mobile gaming history. Please do not install if you won't spend.

Don't play if you can't pay. You'll never keep up with the big spenders if you don't spend. You want the skin from the fishing tournament? Don't bother, the rankings to acquire it have already been bought by big spenders. Very little content for free to play folks and if you're content with that you'll probably get destroyed by a big spender for "playing farmville". There's a reason there's over 1000 states after a little over a year since launch, no-one can play nice and states just die.

Spent enough time playing to understand you will never stand a real chance in the game without spending any money, constantly asks you to buy "deals" and punishment for not purchasing is restricted gameplay, lower scoreboard rankings meaning smaller rewards meaning longer to progress. "Free" lootboxes and treasure are poor quality items, the game itself has been made to heavily favour pay to win. Great concept ruined by greed.

Misleading ads. Also wait times prohibitively long to enjoy f2p gameplay. Devs, I know you need to make a profit but if you're going to add a f2p option at least make it useable. Otherwise just make it a paid game with a "box price". I don't like these predatory tactics. You take advantage of the hope that people will lose track of what they've spent with these ongoing micro transactions and it doesn't give me faith in you. I will not use your products.

I really don't understand this game it's absolutely terrible! Nothing like how was advertised what so ever! I've been playing a while now waiting for it to pick up and it just hasn't... False game with fake advertising. It's just building stuff nothing to do with harvesting what so ever. Don't bother wasting time like I did the adverts are more fun to play than the actual game!!!

FALSE ADVERTISEMENT 😂 Nothing like the advertisement I had for this game while on Duolingo...so after playing for a little bit in the hopes it'll get to the part from the advertisement (ps it never did ) my review is - They really want you to pay for things. Very quickly things need 2 days waiting time for updates in the game so you're left either waiting or paying to finish them quicker. It is fun in the first three days when things don't get so long to upgrade.

Sadly, as with all these types of games, the developers allow much more powerful players to ruin the game for new starters by letting them attack you. I've only been playing a few days, really enjoying the theme and building away only to log on today and find that not one but two players have attacked me. Both were much more advanced than me, and I stood no chance. The developers will of course say buy a peace shield etc, but why should we? There needs to be fair play. Game uninstalled

A fun game to begin with, but it will become evident that you need to spend lots of money on in app purchases to progress in the game.However once you get to a certain level and status, you become bird feed for the higher players that gang up on you to get you out of the area and even to a different state, this ruins the game, not enjoyable at all, despite spending a lot of money myself and playing for a few years, ive requested account deletion and won't be playing again.

Is this actually a game? The little demo game that convinced me to download this is not in the game. While this "game" looks pretty it is just a load of timers. Start building this, it will take 10mins, wait or use crystals? Once out of crystals it's just waiting for timers (some take hours). The expeditions part is fun for about five mins. It is sort of city building by numbers. Build this here! Upgrade this! I can't believe people pay money for the things which are continually advertised. 👎

A fun game to begin with, but it'll quickly become evident that in order to progress, you'll need to spend a lot of money on in-app purchase, and I mean a LOT. However, once you get to a certain status and power in the game, it becomes increasingly "tribal" with other players ganging up to force you to comply with their wishes, and threaten with consequences if you fail to comply. This totally ruins the game and, despite spending a lot of money, I uninstalled the app and deleted my account

Great game. Though it is nothing like the ads. it is another build your city and army, World map showing the hundreds of other players, npcs, and alliances. it does get expensive and (later on) you find yourself spending anywhere from £10 to over £50 a week on upgrades or trying to keep up with others.

Fake ad nothing like gameplay. Advert showed fast-paced game similar to overcooked where polar bears were hunted, their meat cooked and then sold, all at different stations. The game itself is actually a typical base building game where you need to wait for buildings to build or upgrade and can pay to speed things up. Starting to get sick of all the recent mobile ads that showcase fun minigames but turn out to be base building games with perhaps 3% of the gameplay as advertised.

Well at first it was great. Now it went downhill. My server is dying out, no more active players to find for my alliance (I'm in an older server). Merge is much needed, do something before you loose players altogether. You got too greedy for your own good. People don't want to play anymore because of how much you charge for packs. Research centre is insane! I'm on fire levels now and still tech is dragging me down. To reiterate, I used to really enjoy the game but now..Just frustrated. One star

This game is a standard type that you will find many variations of. You upgrade your buildings in a sequence, limited (in this case) by the central furnace. After the initial upgrade levels, you can fight others on the world map. It is dull and repetitive very quickly. Reaching a higher level makes no difference because enemies are matched to your level. Then repeat the same gameplay loop forever.

It's either you spend your whole day on this game to stay a bit competitive or you need to spend tons of money ( hundreds of dollars every month). It's a Pay to win game disguised as Free to play with no ads. There is no point in playing when it gives an edge to everyone who spends or else you'll fall behind. Play this game if you're okay being lame in it without spending any money. It feels like we're doing well at first but it's a different story as it progresses. Please don't download.

Seems like a good game with effort gone into the story telling. (Update) after spending time playing the game I still haven't understood what you are supposed to acheive. Just as you get built up players that are double your level teleport next to you, destroy your army then teleport away. All in all it seems like a good game on the surface but there is just no point in playing it. No real end goals to aim for, just build your town so someone can clear it. Plus serious overheating issues.

Really good game , but not understanding how such low level player ie 400k can beat a 1.1m strong player , but then I fight a 600k strong and still lose . As you get passed level 16 it takes forever to do things , some upgrades take 5 days , power up takes forever and building are taking longer and longer , the game itself is really good but not understanding the power and ko things , once everyone is an alliance there is noone else to fight . You can pay for stuff,but im poor and can't afford

No life game. You have to be on it 24/7 otherwise you can get attacked by others or kicked out by your own clan. Also need loads ($1,000's) of money in order to progress after a certain point. Played it for 13 months and had enough of it. If you don't have a life, jobless and want to spend approximately 5 to 6 hours on a game, then go for it.

Scummy ads aside (this game does not resemble them), there is fairly rapidly a Wall in this game. If you overcome it by joining a predatory clan, and grinding (as in hours a day, for years), there is a more impenetrable wall where progress ceases entirely. Even if you go for the pay-to-win route, most things paid for are ephemeral and hit the same wall unless you're willing to unload all your money. And if you go on holiday for a week you might as well give up as it takes weeks to recover.

Nothing like the stupid adverts. It's slow, tedious with so many unnecessary pop-up game clips that it just adds to the annoyance. This game could be good if it were simplified. It's overly complicated, probably because various parts are designed by different teams, with no coordination. By all means give it ago but don't waste your money on it. There are so many much better products....like Chess.

This, Kingshot, Dark war survival, if you've played 1 you've played them all, they start out like fun little mini games then the map opens up and it's a war game where you need to upgrade troops and fight to defend your resources, PAY TO WIN, the main people on the server are the ones that pay the most, stronger items, stronger hero's, stronger troops, upgrade faster, if you don't pay you will be left behind and farmed for resources

I was enjoying this game a lot for 8-9 months. playing daily and even spending money on it. however, it was too easy for other players to come along and raid your city causing my enjoyment to drop. I would wake up or finish work to find that all my troops were dead and I now had to either spend all my money or wait days to be back to full strength. all because some other player was able to attack me 5 times in a row. very disappointed as I did enjoy the game **changed to 1* because reply

The game is ok but the advert and screenshots are a complete lie. It plays nothing like you see or is advertised and while there are no ads, it's a P2W game. If you don't invest, you'll really struggle. Devs said the ads represent different aspects of the game - Absolute trash. NONE of what you see in these adds happen in game. These ads represent an ENTIRELY DIFFERENT game. If the game they created was based on these ads it might be enjoyable but they are not.

I played this for over 2 years, and it's pay-to-win. You can play it for free, but you'll make very little progress. It's a good game, and I did enjoy it, but it's wallet-heavy if you want to progress. Ultimately, you're always on catch-up unless you want to be a whale, and then you'll be skint. I uninstalled it because it got a bit repetitive with the same events being rehashed. If you want a fun game that will keep you occupied, go for it, but keep an eye on your spending.

Good but limitations. It requires daily engagement and there is little to no tutorials. I've been a non-paying player for a few years and built upto 6* but are still getting targeted. Alliances will require a minimum power and will kick you out without notice, won't provide guidance to new players or are too quiet. If you enjoy battle games this is good but you'll need to build your city as you'll get annulated. This is built on paying. Activities and rules makes it a complex game to learn.

Honestly, I just wanted to play the game in the ad and I was very disappointed to see that this game is nothing like that. It's an alright game. The graphics and story are nice and the voice acting is surprisingly good but there's often way too much happening at once and those build times are ridiculous. It gets to a point where you research something, have to upgrade to unlock the next one and then you have to wait five hours only for it to repeat. It's stupid and makes me not want to play.

Massively p2w. While you can play as f2p, you'll always be massively behind. The game uses a lot of predatory tactics to make you spend. Most mini games within the game are casino type. Looks nothing like the pictures in the ads (there's no mini games like that within the game either). Customer support is absolutely the worst I've ever encountered. The game should be 18+ due to the community being able to type freely and often there are child inappropriate conversations/references thrown about.

The advertisement to get you to download the game is nothing like the actual game, and then constantly trying to get you to buy packs while on the game. Some rewards you can't complete without paying money. The game is dominated by pay to win players who'll spend thousands on the game to be top while the players who dont spend money are forced to feed off the scraps as there's no way to only play with other free to play players. Would be a 5 stars if it wasn't so unbalanced.

Got bombarded with the playable ad enough I figure I'd try it. The gameplay is nothing like the ad - however still decent enough. You want to play a lot at first (I guess designed to suck you in), then upgrading times take ages (to try and force you to pay to speed it up). I'm never paying for a game, so playing it less and less. After a while you finally get little mini games almost like the ad, those are more fun, but after a day or two they seem to dissappear. Overall OK but losing interest.

This is just a copy of very old games with a few tweaks.Total Battle and Total War were games I played and hated for the same reason I hate this game. It is totally Pay To Win and all your hard grind in building troops can be gone in just a few days of starting, so you have to teleport for the same thing to happen all over again. It's probably a great game if you like to splash the cash, but not for me.

Same shi different day. Exactly the same as all the other games of this style build a base, collect resources, join a clan, attack other people's base. Wait for hours/days to do anything the further you get on or get to a point where you end up having to spend hundreds of pounds/euros on micro transactions to stay ahead. Also the adverts that you keep getting interrupting better games a completely unrepresentative they don't show anything to do with this game.

This game is a showcase for wallet size. It's sad that they call it a game. Also it's not like moderate spending would help you. I spent more than 200 british pounds in a month only to get BULLIED by big spenders. And I wasn't even rude to them. I'm warning you THIS IS NOT A GAME. IT'S A SCAM. I'd happily pay a fixed amount to buy a certain thing that anyone can buy. But to have the option to pay as much as you want is insane. People spend thousands of dollars per month to keep their position.

This game kept me invested for longer than most games, but in the end is still just a way to get you to spend money. The early to mid game is fine, it feels like you can keep up without spending a ton, but as you reach the late game all the top players are sinking big money into their accounts, and you'll struggle to remain relevant without doing the same. That being said it still was genuinely enjoyable for alot longer than most mobile games.

Really such a shame, out of all the types of game this style it probably felt the most promising. A lot of fun at the start, so quickly it just simply is pay 2 win. Our whole server just quit as one guy spent over £30k. There should be more events for 90% of the players that aren't pay to win. Even try a server that you pay £10 to enter then can actually be about strategy as the games tag suggests. Unfortunately strategy is completely taken away from a game like this. Which makes it pointless.

This is a fantastic game , but the support is horrendous. I recently told them about an issue where a quest in the game was not tracking. I provided a screen shot of this. their response was , you ve only done five of these.. i clearly give them a screen shot showing that only three had tracked after telling them I've done 5 of them... basically did everything they could to tell me I was the one in the wrong , even though they had the evidence in front of them. Game 10/10 Support 1/10

I downloaded and played for about 5 minutes. theres no aim to the game, upgrades do not cost anything so whats the point? im upgrading until I need to upgrade something else to unlock more upgrades. theres no aim or point in the game. other reviews are saying it becomes pay to win so theres no point in continuing to play. the pictures also do not match with the gameplay at all. im just tapping upgrade and waiting 5 seconds to upgrade, going to the checklist to see what to upgrade next. pointless

Games is good, looks nice and visually pleasing. Mechanics seem okay aside from the fact you only get one builder (without having to pay). Big issue as soon as you get past level 4/5 when everything is taking a bit longer. Can only imagine what it's like at later levels. Cool gimic but strongarms you into spending money 10/15mins into the game.

Game is great when you first start out. But after level 20. It turns into a pay to win game and progress takes a long time unless you are willing to throw cash at it. That's even with collecting the free stuff they give you. 7 days to upgrade your furnace to level23 and 8 hours to train troops and upgrade your low level troop's. Makes the game boring unless you are willing to buy speed ups.

Another build a base game. I played the small ad demo and that was a way better game. Sucking up ice and clearing resources etc. Why can't developers make the game that's advertised. They know what people want but they never make the thing that ls advertised. It was the ad game that made me download this game. When I found its just another build a base game, I unistalled it. Don't ge me wrong nice graphics and nice to see a bit if a story with this game but it's not what was first advertised.

BEWARE! Can be fun, but it is nothing like the adverts you see - fake news maybe. I found it gets very laborious after level 19, and the wallet assault is on. READ ingame adverts carefully and presume they are not telling you something, because they won't be. As I found out, buying a feature to "Add" a queue actually means taking away the ability you ALREADY HAVE to 'rent' it in game, so not actually adding another one at all. I can't advise against paying for content enough... once bitten!

Was a good game , was having fun . Had the WORST interaction with customer support , tried to point out that I redeemed a code , and didn't receive the rewards. Pointed out that I did not want them to give them to me or anything for free and just wanted to point out the error. They proceeded to call me a liar for the next 3 days and I am still getting messages even after telling them repeatedly to stop and I was just trying to point out a bug. I mean who knew customer support could harass you

Seems like a decent idle game to start off with and pass time.Easy to level up at the start but then it gets slow as expected. The only annoying thing I found was that any level could attack your base and kill or injure your troops over and over again. You need troops for gather resources. Why isn't there a cap so people can only attack people similar to their level.. I didn't see people on clash of clans, town hall 10s attacking town hall 5s when I was playing it..

Horrible. It is a solid pay to win game, if you aren't paying for the boosts and items then you are just a farm for the whales. Can't even delete your account, been trying to get a hold of support but I don't think it exists. They want your account there to give the false impression that a lot of people play. There is funny people in the game so if you just want a chatting room then sure, go ahead. Be ready for creepy people though. Been playing over a month in the top state alliance.Toxic game

A good game for a while then it becomes a slog. It starts of exciting, then slowly it becomes a chore, more resources required, days and weeks to upgrade things. Constant deals on which widens the gaps between casuals and spenders. A lot of the game mechanics come down to the big players. An alliance with one big whale will beat an alliance that has on average stronger players but doesn't have the bonuses of that big players. Players are always leaving making the game boring too by the day.

Don't download it. Nothing like their adverts.. it starts out as a fun little base builder but soon reality will settle in. This is a social game where your strength determines your worth and you will be competing against people paying $100-$10,000 a month. As the time goes on those that play for free fall out of relevancy, those you give in an pay will always be at the mercy of those who pay more.. besides that the combat is very basic and the whole game pretty repetitive. Don't waste your time

The game is entertaining, but all the necessary taps and interactions to get the game going are enormous time sinks, and intentionally so. For example, you can automate certain actions, but only for a premium price. So, free users must spend real-world hours to progress. All is made worse by the fact that, eventually, you are competing against a number of paying users and, so, all your time sunk in the game was for nothing, because nobody can compete with real money. Do not waste your time.

The Ads for this game are a lie, so if you were to go by those, then this is a simple bait and switch game. If you have played State of Survival or any of its clones, then you know what you're getting. it's a clone of State of Survival. You'll be inundated with requests to make purchase after purchase, and the only people that win are the developers. Every time you load the game, you will be given a special offer to purchase, be prepared to spend spend spend if you want to be competitive.

Game is well made graphically and how it plays. But the devs have made it so if you pay you win, which I can understand to a degree as funding for a game is needed, but when you have done every event and built a solid city for a player to be able to easily wipe everything out you have with no way of defending it then the devs have made a mistake. The way this game is setup unless you pour vast amounts of money into it it has a limited gameplay, which is a shame. F2p aren't meant to keep playing

NOTHING LIKE THE ADS. the ads looked cool and fun, but after playing for around 10 minutes it got boring. There isn't much to do, and based off the other reviews, it's extremely pay to win. The responses to all the reviews are pre-generated if that's the word, nobody actually reads or takes the reviews seriously. Do not download. I've heard that p2w players will crush you in a matter of seconds no matter how much you have. Terrible. One review said 100k to max one character. What?? This is scam.

Fun at first, but after playing for about 3 weeks you've basically done everything. Progress slows alot, Resource obtainment slows massively with each furnace upgrade (after level 20) becomes insane. The reason for this is to force you to get out of your bubble and attack other players for resources to mimic a "war" game. This isn't a good war game though, no strategy just who has the better troops and unfortunately it's very easy to fall behind the P2W players. Events aren't great either.

Deleted, I should have read reviews, Another game that is nothing like adverts. The advert game looks fun! However this is the rubbish usual pay to win game that you have to join an alience and unless you pay lots of money to upgrade the top alience won't let you in, so you repeatedly get hammered. Save the anguish and don't download.

1star as long as willful misleading advertising. As for the game? At level 22 and still no idea, no proper explanation (just setting up initial facilities) eg what all the acquired tokens for? Fighting outcomes don't relate relative level, if not 5 above then defeated. Game becomes another group war game, pointless if everyone in different time zones. Pointless, no skills, exponential time to rise a level (8days from level 22), very expensive to buy small resources.

There is no gameplay here, the 'game' is a linear set of upgrades that take incrementally longer to complete. You are encouraged to speed up these arbitrary timers with microtransactions. No idea who this game is for, as surely even whales would find it boring if they can just purchase the endgame. The advert contained gameplay that was nothing like the final product - the company clearly recognises that their gameplay is not appealing.

Literally nothing like the entertaining game in the adverts which pop up in literally every ad supported game on Play (eg Infinity Minesweeper). Are these really nothing to do with the developers? I've never seen an ad for the actual game. Dont waste people's time and look into your adverts yourselves. You must be paying someone for these clicks.

It is a good game but !!! Like everything, I am on furnace 20, and now it's starting to drag. I have wasted a ton of money I don't really want to waste no more it's getting boring now to the point I can't be bothered to play with it it's not a bad game at all unless you are willing to spend money to get moving faster the graphic are good I like the hero's and the building a city up

Nothing like the ad. The game itself is one of those boring ones where you have to wait a certain time before something gets built. I played the ad and that was so much fun. I don't why they have to lie and just make what is advertised. The one that is advertised is so much more simpler and would be easy to make. Don't waste your time downloading it.

It's a great game, but it has some issues that really drag it down: * Rampant bullying and death threats on multiple servers that are ignored by the Devs. * Pay-to-Win destroys any type of fair competition * Lots of activities over the week, but all encourage you to pay hard cash to win the best prizes and boosts. * Very little chance of getting high level gear unless you pay. * Construction/Research times become ridiculously long the Higher you go, pushing you to pay money to quicken them.

The game is entertaining, and while it constantly encourages you to pay to progress. It is possible to play for free and extract some enjoyment (but you need to join an alliance which has a lot of paying players in order to get that enjoyment). Be warned, if you're unfortunate enough to need the help of Customer Support, you're likely to be disappointed. They're very polite but totally useless when it comes to getting anything fixed. There are definitely better ways to spend your time and money.

Really sneaky - nothing like the advert I followed from another app. Literally different games. They make it incredibly hard to delete your account (they have to approve your 'request') . The game seems designed to be addictive with constant incentivisation. Contains gambling - spin a wheel for prizes, buy more tickets for cash. I worry about children downloading this. It should be banned.

The game itself was OK but it didn't keep me coming back to it. Ended up uninstalling the game after not playing for a week. Side note though. I have yet to see an advert for this game that shows the actual game instead of something you can't do within the game. The Devs must have hired the same advertising team team that likes to use sound bite and screen shots from the command and conquer franchise.

This game is NOT the same thing what gets advertised and the playable demo. Rubbish! dear editor, I've played this game every day for 3 or 4 months and I've never ever chopped trees with axes or killed bears with spinning axes and collecting meat and building forts like you do in the mini demo! NEVER ONCE!

Great game. Although it can feel a bit P2W at times you can actually get quite far without paying. However if you do pay you'll be way ahead. Will have to see in late game if it's completely owned by P2W players. Overall game is addicting and fun, you can also spend very little and enjoy for hours and hours.

There's nothing wrong with the game except I don't like playing cooperatively but apparently people need to be in an alliance with others. Whiteout Survival is not how I would define "casual" as there is too much to do to progress. The game is simply too time consuming and since the story is quite interesting can only succeeded in wasting the player's life until he or she isekai into it a la 'Overlord'.

Its great in the beginning, the team building aspect.. but that very quickly dies and you're left with boring repetitive events that require a lot of items and give such little reward. The game however does have a lot of potential, alot of Intrinsic features but it's massively wasted...and I wouldn't even say in favour of whale spenders, tbh I don't even know why they bother, the game is ruined by people able to spend $4-500 a day because there is no challenge, there is no worthy battle anymore

Really good game, one feature I would like games like this to add is free to play servers, where you can't spend real money to gain an advantage over players, all your big spenders all group in big alliance and tend to ruin the server for those who can't spend. And end up quiting the game because its just impossible to keep up. I feel like this would give the game more structure and keep customers engaged with the game for longer.

Lies. Played the advert. Loved it. The actual game is nothing like the advert game which was much better and much more fun. The actual game isn't fun or interesting. Why make the advert actually good if you can't play that? Release that as a game and I'd download it in a heartbeat. This app is absolute trash and definitely falsely advertised.

Fun but hard to stay with it long term. Starts of with a simple click and collect intro to the game but then as like all games it becomes harder and longer to get things done. This is fine as still new stuff opens up. The hardest issue now especially for new players is there are alliances in the states that are far too powerful. Alliances need cutting down rather than 1 or 2 ruling parties dominating the game and it becoming boring.

It's good, no really it is. The online community is great and I've met some great people. It's the upgrade times - dear God they're long, really long. You can speedup and get a lot of them in game but obviously, more if you pay. Spent a lot, my choice but just be aware. Graphics are fab, tutorials are plentiful - it's just the upgrade times!! Please fix dev and Father Christmas will bring you lots of lovely things:)

The gameplay is absolutely nothing like what's shown in the fake ads. The real gameplay is very basic, and while ok for a while, it doesn't take long to get boring. You can't progress far without either waiting ridiculously long times or by paying lots of money. It essentially becomes a pay to win or pay to play game.

ABSOLUTELY NOTHING like the add, the game in the add was fun, the game in reality is a boring ball of complete whack! & from what I see from other reviews it just gets worse, why are games allowed to pull this ****, you would advertise a range rover when selling a pushbike as would be done by trading standards, so how come these scam artists allowed to get away with it! If you feel your game isn't good enough to be truthful in the add then you are basically telling us it's complete garbage

What a lie. Advertised this as a single player, no mention of PvP. Standard online game where you fight other people and build. I would have never given it a try if I know. Hate these games too toxic and no way of switching chat off. No way of preventing getting attacked or removing that aspect of the game. The game is fine and I was enjoying it until I reached a development stage where the PvP aspect comes in and I only then realised. Review done and game is being deleted. False advertising!

Whiteout Survival isn’t what the adverts or pictures make it look like. It’s just another generic base-building and resource management game. The ads show intense survival gameplay, but in reality, it’s mostly waiting around for materials and upgrading buildings. There’s nothing unique or standout about it compared to dozens of similar games.

Great game, spoilt only by the crazy cost of a shield during play. The most expensive cost in any game I have played and a waste of time reporting anything as ghe customer services give the same message that they will look at the matter. Result of looking into the matter is exactly nothing. Unless you are willing to spend a whole lot of money I would avoid this game.

This game will make your phone overheat and eat about 20% of your battery in half an hour. All of the advertisements online I have seen depict gameplay that never happens in the game. Aesthetically it's just a cheap knock-off of Frostpunk, right down the furnace in the centre of the town you have to choose when to turn on and for how long (a false choice, as it turns out, because coal is so abundant you can leave your furnace on all the time). A miserable waste of time.

Not the game shown in the pictures or advert. played for 5 minutes, where you're taken through a tutorial of building the town. There is no collecting of wood and building the walls from the inside like the playable ad. From my 5minutes playing it's the same as all the others, upgrade and wait or pay. May be okay, but not the advertised game.

Heavy p2w game. Typical answer as expected. Yes is free to download, the progress in game without spending is ridiculous and the amount of free item you get it won't help develop your account even as a rally filler in 2 years (fact) ask your community, so please don't sell me this cheap AI text, tried it for a couple of months and shared my opinion about your game. Good luck in your future endeavors!

Started playing this game a year ago. I tried building it without using any money but it was nearly impossible. Spent good chunk of money and still get fed by people who have spent large amounts. To be in a good power you need to spend more than 60k. There is not much for F2P. Everything needs money consistently. If someone spends this much on Fortnite they would have unbeatable account.

It's a really good game, however it's just so repetitive. I find myself logging in once every one to two weeks now (I used to log in daily) and I have no idea what half of the items do/events are. New bits keep getting added but it doesn't seem to make it more interesting. I keep coming back because I don't want to lose progress because upgrading everything is so time consuming. I also wish the appearance of everything changed with every upgrade - it would make it more satisfying.

Really enjoy this game, although I think a lot depends on what alliance you're in. The comments about spending do matter, but as long as you do the events you don't really need to spend money (most stuff can be got with gems, which you obtain in events). It gets a little slower the more you progress, but again if you do events ot doesn't matter.

Nice game & graphics. But I am personally against any kind of battle/fighting in any games /films/TV shows that youngsters. May be ablebto access. so as much as I was enjoying the main game with the building, Helping and nursing / farming within the game the fighting actually put me off so I have uninstalled it .But we'll done to the developers for an interesting take on a farm/city game .

I usually hate these types of games, but this one is the first I've enjoyed. The novice shield is long enough for you to get a good start on building a city, there's plenty of things to do while you wait for your buildings to complete, and if you get in with a good alliance, the help option to speed up building makes a real difference. Overlapping events add to gameplay. There are paid upgrade packs available, but it isn't necessary to buy them to get on. But the gamechanger? NO ADS!! love it!!

Seems legit, played for many hrs now but I've encountered a real bad problem, you've a some point progress to to where people can attack you and kill your city and steal resources. For new players we need that to build and progress.....which we can't because there constantly being attacked. Game claims to move you randomly after you've been defeated but funny how same people keep attacking. If there was a way of playing the game without being PvP attacked by way higher players

At first, I loved the game. Everything about the game was .. perfect .. However, the more I played, the more I realised it wasn't. The game becomes too repetetive and the objectives are not clear. Not just that, the game needs to make its mind up - is it a war game, an idle game or sim game? I spend ages upgrading toilets in the shelters - for what? The shelters are usless, so is the furnace temperature and the workers schedule - nobody literally cares about it.

This game is NOTHING like the ads. Very misleading ads. The game is heavily stacked in favour of those who spend lots of real world money on resource and speedup packs. Without resource and speedup packs, upgrades take extortionate amounts of time to start and complete, especially after level 20. This completely ruins the game and makes it pointless continuing to play. Furnace level 30 takes 40 days for example unless you pay. You just can't compete with those who pay lots. Rigged game.

It would be a very good game but for several problems. Non stop Lagging & Logging out of the game. This is why I have deleted the game. I am disappointed. Can't progress without the normal amount of payments in every category. Like all similar games, get to a certain point & the game gets boring. Alliance's stop fighting so the only thing to look forward to is SvS. Spend £500 for a few months fun at the Top. You can get good Strength without spending a Fortune but you will never be Powerful

I only downloaded this because it was a boosted game on Mistplay and I don't normally like games like this, at all, but I absolutely LOVE it! Zero ads, really easy to get the hang of and doesn't overwhelm you with loads of tasks and quests. I would normally skip through the dialogue in similar games but this is really engaging, the characters are really likeable and the graphics are beautiful in a simple way. I will certainly be keeping this one, fantastic job 👏 👏👏👏

Not as advertised. I have played this have for few months, it is a city building game, not carry objects game. If you want a game as on adds, THIS IS NOT IT. False advertising should be banned for games. On the other hand as you progress in the game it gets harder and almost impossible without paying moneys.some characters take ages to get.

So it's not littered with ads, and would suggest you try it if you like the look of it. Stolen many ideas from Frostpunk, a beautiful game, but beware it's nothing like it. For me there's far too much going on, without any thought. click lots and collect, gems, cards, coal, iron, heros etc etc etc, upgrade buildings, heros, join alliances. Train troops, attack monsters...etc etc.

Nothing like the ads. Not the game I wanted to play. Just an endless cycle of upgrade this so you can upgrade that so you can do another upgrade. Didn't enjoy it. (Edit in response to reply - the ads were in another mobile game so I cannot link to them directly, there's no way to share them. The link within the ads took me to this Google play page.)

Some people are using multiple accounts to bypass the limit on 2 characters per state. I tried to flag this up to customer services and, while they admit that the rule is there to keep the game balanced and provide a fair and enjoyable experience for all, they have decided not to deal with the issue. It is a shame because the game could be really fun..

Edit: thank you for the clarification. Still very confusing that it's not clear enough from the get go..better UI would help. Anyway, updating the rating since the game's still fun. Upgrade furnace twice. I upgraded from 29 to 30 and then went to upgrade to fire level 1 and spent gems to complete it. Once done, it was still at 30 and asked me to spend same resources again to upgrade.

I love this game. I love the people I've met and I love the game play. Why two stars? Well I've got to level 24 furnace of 30 and I'm BORED. 200 stamina to do stuff which quickly gets burned up on certain events. Two weeks to wait for a furnace upgrade, two days for a bit of tech research to finish. You'll reply to say it's f2p and there's lots on. Yes the events are good. Yes you can play it for free but you've made the higher levels so boring on purpose to make us part with our cash. Greed.

Not bad, easy to play. However... Felt like I constantly had to be on it once id joined a clan/guild, and I dont have time for that. You dont have to spend any money, at all. Its pretty easy to aquire items, including the character cards/upgrades. Good luck with it, one of the better ones ive played, but I don't have the time.

Trash no fun game. super expensive for rubbish upgrades. You don't do anything, just repeatedly send your troops in one direction to attack something then wait, that's it. forget the fun AD what brought you here, it's just base building & timers with hundreds of ways to spend money on nothing, plus you'll just end up as fodder for the whale's

I played this game for about a year and a half. I was part of a great alliance and had a good time, but eventually the game just becomes a money grab. Of course you can play free to play, and that's all good, but it will be tough to progress as quickly as the alliance you join (if you're in an alliance with people who spend a fair amount of $). I worked hard to keep up pace and spent money myself, but ultimately felt like I could be spending that money elsewhere. Just depends on your play style

Absolutely NOTHING like the advert. Total false advertising. It's some upgrade your city game, but very pay to win. Gets very boring very quickly. Wish they'd made the adverts into a real game honestly. Got raided 5 times in one day by a person who had absolutely paid money to buy the maxed out upgrades and lost everything. And there's no way to stop it. Just ruins the experience

Very good game overall. However....it is nothing like the ads. This is a military survival game. it does take a lot of time to advance far enough to be competitive. Many players simply buy their way up. One secret is to join a top 20 alliance in your state where you will not be attacked very much. Otherwise you may be attacked so often after the 5 day newbie phase that the game can be frustrating very quickly.

ok so i'm 5 months in now, I use to play 1st thing in the morning but quite bored now as it's really hard to play as upgrades are silly long to do without paying money, I totally get that game developers need to make money, but wow, makes me wish I was one for the amount they want for somthing thats virtual?! Patience is needed to play this game, but i'm running out.. I won't pay to play sorry, on a plus, there are no intrusive ads tbf 👌

Not the game I was expecting, but far be it for me to expect a game to match it's ads nowadays. This could be enjoyable to someone, but it just isn't for me. The graphics are good, the voice acting is... there.. and the gameplay is alright. Just not my style of game, but I could see someone else liking it. Give it a shot I guess, don't take this as an overtly negative review, it isn't one star cuz this isn't a one star game. Is it a 5 star game? Not to me, but give it a shot and see if it is 4 u

The game is highly addictive and a textbook example of "pay to play." You could end up spending tens or even hundreds of dollars per month, only to still lag behind the whales on your server (during last SvS we calculated in World Chat that an opponent has invested between $20-25k). Since gameplay heavily relies on social interactions with other players, you may find yourself unwillingly spending more and more just to keep up with your alliance—especially during special events. Stay away!!!

There's in app purchases that make your life easier but they're not necessary to play the game. There's no ads, just a pop up or two about content you could purchase. This is the perfect mobile game to scratch that video game itch without dedicating a large chunk of your time. Having said that, it's quite hard to put down sometimes. I enjoy the game. There's a social aspect that I enjoy. It updates frequently so you're constantly interacting with different content. I definitely recommend.

It's just another war of clans/ clash of clans/last war survival/war survival clone. Get far enough into the game, get hit with a semi paywall, if you don't pay it you keep playing but never keep up. You pay it, you're now stuck in an endless loop of 3-7$ purchases because "it's not that much money" but it adds up QUICK

Enjoyed the style of the playable ads, so thought I'd install and give it a try. One minute into the game I realised it's nothing like the ads. I was suckered by the marketing department, and to be honest, I should have known better. Uninstalling.

Game ads are fake and manipulative, game is clan event based. Basically, whoever spends the most money is the strongest. It's a money sink game/pay to win. Save your time and money. Don't download this game. You'll play for a while and eventually never play it again.

it's a trap. the richness of colors and sounds floods your already fried brain with little packets of endorphins, slowly addicting you to the rush. the game developers are skilled drug dealers. the first hit is free. then they squeeze you. a lot. after 2 days of constant gameplay (you'll get hooked) the game actually TAKES AWAY the abilities you already had to start with. break up with it there and then. the construction queue goes from 2 to 1 unless you pay. once you pay, you'll keep paying.

The environment in some states is so toxic. Many players have quit. The amount of bullying is incredible. The Ad that hooked me on the game was false advertisement. I'd like a refund for playing this game and close my account. I've reached out to customer service for a full refund and I keep getting the runaround.

At first, I thought the game was nothing like the ad, BUT, the ad I played is basically 'Daybreak Island', which you acquire a bit later in the game. This is not a solo game unless you just wanna construct your island. Teams and coordinated strategy amongst all allies are encouraged to progress faster. 😀👍🏽✅️

It's cute but not for me. UI is confusing, story is okay. It's just a gacha game with unending grinding. There are vip and passes and in-store purchases for everything to make thing more fun, but these purchases come off as simple money grabs. The very active developers does make this game quite a lot better than I make it sound.

Played before, doesn't match a single ad and the ad minigames actually weren't bad, but this is, it's the shittiest game I've ever had the displeasure of playing. It's so bad that I wouldn't even send this to my worse enemy, or the devil himself, because no one deserves that much torture.

I hope you've money, they say there is a lot of free stuff but it takes way too long to get anything. I've both a F2P and a paid account, even my paid account can be zeroed easy by someone with more money. The devs are very greedy, and doesn't help nor listen to their player base. Hundreds of players have left this game due to how some people become tyrants, or how they keep releasing higher gear, new heroes etc. in such a short time.

it is a big scaming game, at first the ads attract you to this game are very misleading. it is a replica from lords mobile with same frame, so this what will happen, exciting in beginning to continue gaming and engage more in the game, then from no where you will be attack throughly and repeatedly to continue drain your resources, this intentional to spend money to compete..

Was looking for just a simple game like in the ads but it turns out that the game has a nice plot. Haven't experienced and skirmish with other guild yet, but the game is interesting to say the least. Don't like having to pay to play at a high level but againvery nice game

ad isn't anything like the game. I played this on my iPad and checked it out seeing it said 2 and had other gameplay. it's all just a scam. it's a generic city builder game that eventually becomes a grins fest with grindy events you can only get good stuff out of if you pay or you spend every moment on the game. immediate uninstall.

wasn't like the ad at all just another pay to play base building game where you just upgrade buildings again not like the add at all un-installed it in like 10 minutes once I realized there were timers ... there are no timers in the add 100% a base building game where every upgrade gets a bit longer and more expensive... lame

I really don't recommend this game, if you're good at strategies nor wanna save money, we've got city skin event recently for valentine's week special, they merged 5-6 servers together, and only top15 gets the skin for those receiving and giving, totally 30 skins; in general city skin event for single server for top10, now they just merge 5-6 servers and giving only 30 skins was lame, so if you wanna save your time/ money this is not your type game, this game developers only need your money

Saw ad for this 100x in Car Jam. This is NOT what was advertised AT ALL. Seems NONE of the games advertised are like how they are portrayed. No ads means play to win based. Started a survey for rewards & I quit as it never ended. New to mobile games and going back to buying complete games, done with this rubbish.

Wasted way too much of my life. Trying to get to a point in this game that looked anything like the ad that led me to download it. An hour later, still nothing. Removed and came here to leave this review. If you watch the same video I did, don't waste your time, it's just clickbait. This is one of those games I wish they would allow you to give a zero rating on.

nothing like the ads, not a fun game very grindy and pay to win as soon as I realized this I uninstalled and was able to get a refund on one of my two unlock purchases, it's a shame this game is designed to suck money and is pay to win. very disappointed I can't get a refund on a purchase less then 48 hours, well scam successful enjoy my ~4 dollars

Like others have mentioned, the game isn't like in the ad's. However it's a nice game for people who don't like strategy games usually. No annoying ad breaks, no pay 2 win, easy gameplay, quick progression and easy to understand. I haven't grown tired of it despite not beint a fan of this game genre.

this game is absolutely nothing like the ads that convince me to download the game to begin with. once you build up your city you will be attacked repeatedly while you sleep destroying any momentum you've built up. also, this game based on pay to win. it's a money grab and nothing more. stay away from this game.

Entirely controlled by pay to win, to the point where there is no reason to play it unless you're going to be spending hundreds on upgrades. Absolutely no balance at all, spammed events trying to force you to pay for more, terrible servers and then trying to force you to pay to migrate server somewhere closer to your country.

The game is absolutely NOTHING like the pictures or playable ads encountered on websites/Facebook, etc. It is fun for a while but it's geared towards pay to play and can be frustrating if you're NOT inclined to spend money for useless game bits that have no value outside of the game.
